description: Declare or unset challenge winners. Requires confirm set to DECLARE_WINNERS. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

challengeId.description: Challenge ID, from list_products or a challenge tool for this business.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation for this write. Pass the exact literal this tool requires (for example DELETE) only after the user approves the action.

winners.description: Participants to declare as challenge winners.

name: declare_challenge_winners
